stories.title: Google’s Universal Cart shopping tool launches in the US
stories.why: If you shop through Google, AI can now gather items from different stores into one cart, so it's worth comparing prices yourself before you check out.

stories.title: AI agents are coming to Rivian’s cars
stories.why: AI assistants are moving into everyday things like cars, so expect to talk to your next vehicle and check what it records and shares.

stories.title: Amazon’s always-listening Bee wearable can now help you buy stuff
stories.why: Always-listening AI gadgets can now make purchases for you, so if you or your staff wear one, review its privacy and spending settings first.
